extensionDescription.message: Archive a Chrome tab group as a Markdown note in Obsidian, with a link to every tab.

contextMenuSave.message: Save this tab's group to Obsidian

noVaultLink.message: Add a vault name in settings

moreMenuTitle.message: Run another action once. This does not change your default action, which is set in Settings.

moreMenuHelp.message: The ▾ menu runs an action once without changing your default (set in Settings).

emptyWindow.message: No tab groups or tabs in this window.

addVaultFirst.message: Add a vault name in settings first.

firstRunHint.message: Chrome will ask whether to open Obsidian. Tick "Always allow" to skip the question next time. If Obsidian doesn't open, check that the vault name in settings matches Obsidian exactly.

statusHandedInUri.message: Handed to Obsidian (clipboard unavailable, sent in link)

tabsClosedMessage.message: Tabs closed. Chrome still lists this group under the Chrome menu → Tab groups; use Delete group there if you want it gone.

checkThenSendNext.message: Check that the note arrived in Obsidian, then send the next one.

confirmClose.message: Once the notes show up in Obsidian, close the tabs you saved?

sentInUriStayOpen.message: Groups sent without the clipboard stay open, in case the note was cut short.

alreadyRun.message: This save has already run. You can close this tab.

closesOnItsOwn.message: This tab closes on its own once Obsidian opens.

primaryActionLabel.message: Main button action (the other two stay in the ▾ menu)

skipRestricted.message: List chrome:// and other restricted pages under "Not archived" instead of erroring

writeBookmarks.message: Also save each group as a bookmark folder under Archived groups (Chrome can reopen it as a group)
